disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了所有源码文件（src/ 目录、脚本文件），检查是否读取敏感路径（如 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa、.aws/credentials）。未发现任何凭据路径读取代码。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source files (src/ directory, script files) to check whether they read sensitive paths (such as .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, .aws/credentials). No credential path reading code was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了凭据枚举语义（如「find API keys」「grep -R TOKEN」等命令模式）。未发现凭据枚举或批量搜集行为的代码。
checked_items.en: Checked for credential enumeration semantics (e.g., command patterns such as "find API keys", "grep -R TOKEN"). No code for credential enumeration or bulk collection was found.

evidence.zh: 不适用。插件为浏览器端命令面板，纯客户端 UI，不包含任何凭据文件读取代码路径。未发现 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh 等敏感路径的读取操作，也没有网络外发能力可传递凭据。
evidence.en: Not applicable. The plugin is a browser-side command palette, a pure client-side UI, with no code path for reading credential files. No reads of sensitive paths such as .credentials.yaml or ~/.ssh were found, and there is no outbound network capability that could exfiltrate credentials.

checked_items.zh: 审查了所有注册工具的描述、系统提示词注入点。插件未使用 ctx.tools.register 注册任何工具，也未使用 ctx.systemPrompt.section() 注入系统提示词。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the descriptions of all registered tools and system prompt injection points. The plugin does not register any tools via ctx.tools.register, nor does it inject system prompts via ctx.systemPrompt.section().

checked_items.zh: 审查了模型面指令文件（AGENTS.md、.agents/skills/ 下的 7 个 SKILL.md，即规则 DSH-X10 命中面）。内容均为本仓库的开发者协作指南和插件模板工作流文档，不含注入指令、凭证诱导或远程指令加载文本。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the model-facing instruction files (AGENTS.md, 7 SKILL.md files under .agents/skills/, i.e., the hit surface of rule DSH-X10). The contents are developer collaboration guides for this repository and plugin template workflow documents, with no injected instructions, credential lures, or remote instruction loading text.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 agent/pre-step 消息改写监听器。插件未监听 agent/pre-step 事件，不存在运行时消息篡改面。
checked_items.en: Checked for agent/pre-step message rewriting listeners. The plugin does not listen to the agent/pre-step event, so there is no runtime message tampering surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 CompactionEngine 子类化（上下文压缩篡改）。插件未继承或实现 CompactionEngine，不存在历史压缩篡改面。
checked_items.en: Checked for CompactionEngine subclassing (context compression tampering). The plugin neither inherits nor implements CompactionEngine, so there is no history compression tampering surface.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，不存在工具描述投毒面。审查了 AGENTS.md 和 7 个 SKILL.md 文件，内容均为仓库内的开发者协作文档和模板工作流指南，不包含系统指令、凭证读取诱导或越权指令。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any tools, so there is no tool description poisoning surface. Reviewed AGENTS.md and 7 SKILL.md files; the contents are developer collaboration documents and template workflow guides within the repository, containing no system instructions, credential read lures, or unauthorized instructions.

evidence.zh: 插件的工具描述和文档中不含诱导安装其他插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。README 的安装说明为标准的 dsh plugin add 命令，不含隐藏指令。
evidence.en: The plugin's tool descriptions and documentation contain no wording that lures installation of other plugins, rewriting of configurations, or granting of permissions. The README installation instructions use the standard dsh plugin add command, with no hidden instructions.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听 agent/pre-step 事件，不存在在模型请求前改写或注入用户消息的途径。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to the agent/pre-step event, so there is no way to rewrite or inject user messages before model requests.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 YAML 配置中的 `!!js` 标量（规则 DSH-P01）。cordis.patch.yml 仅包含一个简单的 insert 行，不含任何 `!!js` 标签。SKILL.md 文档中对 `!!js` 的提及是插件开发规范说明文字，不是实际 YAML 配置值，排除为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked the `!!js` scalar in the YAML configuration (rule DSH-P01). cordis.patch.yml contains only a simple insert line, with no `!!js` tags. The mention of `!!js` in the SKILL.md document is explanatory text in the plugin development specification, not an actual YAML configuration value, and is ruled benign.

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态代码执行函数（eval、new Function、child_process，规则 DSH-X03）。运行时源码（src/ 目录）中未使用这些函数。构建脚本（scripts/prepare.mjs）使用 child_process 运行本地 tsc/tsdown 编译工具，scripts/extract-patch.mjs 使用 child_process 执行 git 命令，均为开发期工具，不随插件运行时加载，排除为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked dynamic code execution functions (eval, new Function, child_process, rule DSH-X03). These functions are not used in the runtime source code (src/ directory). The build script (scripts/prepare.mjs) uses child_process to run the local tsc/tsdown compilation tools, and scripts/extract-patch.mjs uses child_process to execute git commands; both are development-time tools that are not loaded at plugin runtime, and are ruled benign.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 cordis_define/cordis_run 调用。源码中未调用这些动态包工具。
checked_items.en: Checked cordis_define/cordis_run calls. These dynamic package tools are not invoked in the source code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 install 钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare，规则 DSH-X02）。package.json 的 prepare 脚本运行 node scripts/prepare.mjs，仅执行本地 TypeScript 编译器和 tsdown 打包工具，无网络访问，无敏感文件写入，排除为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare, rule DSH-X02). The prepare script in package.json runs node scripts/prepare.mjs, which only executes the local TypeScript compiler and the tsdown bundler, with no network access and no writes to sensitive files, ruled benign.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 client bundle（dsh.client 声明）的键盘监听（规则 DSH-X05）。客户端 bundle 为命令面板 UI，keydown 事件监听器用于快捷键打开/关闭面板、导航搜索结果和快捷键录制，属于命令面板的核心功能。未发现键盘记录、剪贴板访问或 credentials.set RPC 调用，排除为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked the keyboard listeners of the client bundle (dsh.client declaration, rule DSH-X05). The client bundle is a command palette UI; its keydown event listener is used for opening/closing the palette via shortcuts, navigating search results, and recording shortcuts, which is core command palette functionality. No keylogging, clipboard access, or credentials.set RPC calls were found, ruled benign.

checked_items.zh: 检查了子代理委托（subagents.registerProvider）。未发现 registerProvider 调用。
checked_items.en: Checked subagent delegation (subagents.registerProvider). No registerProvider calls were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 dsh 原生持驻（jobs.start、schedule_create、goals）。未发现这些持驻注册。
checked_items.en: Checked dsh native persistent tasks (jobs.start, schedule_create, goals). No such persistent task registrations were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 agent/turn-stopping 轮次续命监听。未发现此事件监听器。
checked_items.en: Checked the agent/turn-stopping turn-extension listener. No such event listener was found.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 内容为纯 insert 操作（插入一行 dsh-spotlight 插件配置），不含 `!!js`、`!!js/function` 或 `!!js/regexp` 标签，不存在通过 YAML 标量在宿主进程执行任意代码的风险。
evidence.en: The content of cordis.patch.yml is a pure insert operation (inserting one line of dsh-spotlight plugin configuration), containing no `!!js`, `!!js/function`, or `!!js/regexp` tags, so there is no risk of arbitrary code execution in the host process via YAML scalars.

evidence.zh: 源码中未调用 cordis_define 或 cordis_run，不存在模型通过动态包工具在 node:vm 中执行代码的途径。
evidence.en: The source code does not call cordis_define or cordis_run, so there is no path for the model to execute code in node:vm via dynamic package tools.

evidence.zh: package.json 声明了 prepare 脚本，但该脚本仅运行本地 tsc/tsdown 编译工具，不访问网络，不写入仓库外目录。README 推荐的 Git 安装方式使用了 `#main` 浮动引用，属于卫生问题（用户在安装时宜锁定 commit），但代码本身无恶意行为。
evidence.en: package.json declares a prepare script, but it only runs the local tsc/tsdown compilation tools, does not access the network, and does not write outside the repository directory. The Git installation method recommended in the README uses a `#main` floating reference, which is a hygiene issue (users should pin a commit when installing), but the code itself has no malicious behavior.

evidence.zh: manifest 声明了 dsh.client。客户端 bundle 为命令面板 UI，键盘事件监听器用于快捷键操作（打开/关闭面板、导航搜索结果）和快捷键录制功能，属于插件的核心特性。未发现键盘记录、剪贴板读取或 credentials.set 等特权 RPC 调用。
evidence.en: The manifest declares dsh.client. The client bundle is a command palette UI, and the keyboard event listener is used for shortcut operations (opening/closing the palette, navigating search results) and shortcut recording, which are core plugin features. No keylogging, clipboard reads, or privileged RPC calls such as credentials.set were found.

evidence.zh: 未发现 ctx.subagents.registerProvider 调用，不存在将轮次委派给外部子代理的面。
evidence.en: No ctx.subagents.registerProvider calls were found, so there is no surface for delegating turns to external subagents.

evidence.zh: 未发现 jobs.start、schedule_create、create_goal/update_goal 等 dsh 原生持驻注册，也不存在 agent/turn-stopping 轮次续命监听器。
evidence.en: No dsh native persistent task registrations such as jobs.start, schedule_create, or create_goal/update_goal were found, nor is there an agent/turn-stopping turn-extension listener.

checked_items.zh: 检查了网络外发代码（fetch、XMLHttpRequest、WebSocket、node:net、curl/wget 等）。运行时源码（src/ 目录）中无任何网络请求调用。插件仅通过 Cordis 服务名注入（ctx.get）读取宿主服务的本地接口，不发起 HTTP 或其他网络请求。
checked_items.en: Checked outbound network code (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, node:net, curl/wget, etc.). The runtime source code (src/ directory) contains no network request calls. The plugin only reads local interfaces of host services via Cordis service name injection (ctx.get), and does not make HTTP or other network requests.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 LLM 路由劫持（agent/request 监听器、registerAdapter）。未发现 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件监听器，未发现 registerAdapter 调用。
checked_items.en: Checked LLM route hijacking (agent/request listeners, registerAdapter). No agent/request or agent/request-error event listeners were found, and no registerAdapter calls were found.

evidence.zh: 未发现 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件监听器，未发现 registerAdapter 调用。不存在运行时劫持 LLM 路由到未声明端点的途径。
evidence.en: No agent/request or agent/request-error event listeners were found, and no registerAdapter calls were found. There is no path to hijack LLM routes to undeclared endpoints at runtime.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 patch 文件是否触碰安全配置行（sandbox、approval、permission）或含 disabled:true、mode: !!js process.env.* 等降权写法。cordis.patch.yml 仅作 insert 操作，内容完全无害。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the patch file touches security configuration lines (sandbox, approval, permission) or contains privilege-lowering patterns such as disabled:true or mode: !!js process.env.*. cordis.patch.yml only performs an insert operation, and its content is completely harmless.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 prepend 监听安全事件（tools/pre-execute、approval/request）。未发现此类监听器，不存在审批链短路风险。
checked_items.en: Checked prepend listeners on security events (tools/pre-execute, approval/request). No such listeners were found, so there is no risk of short-circuiting the approval chain.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖锁定和版本引用。所有依赖均为 registry 包（npm registry），无 Git 依赖或本地依赖。
checked_items.en: Checked dependency locking and version references. All dependencies are registry packages (npm registry), with no Git dependencies or local dependencies.

checked_items.zh: 检查了作者身份风险。作者账号 0xsline 在 GitHub 上活跃，仓库为公开的 DSH 插件模板仓库。
checked_items.en: Checked author identity risk. The author account 0xsline is active on GitHub, and the repository is a public DSH plugin template repository.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 patch 是否改写 inject/intercept 配置。cordis.patch.yml 不触碰这些字段。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the patch rewrites inject/intercept configurations. cordis.patch.yml does not touch these fields.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅插入一行插件配置，不含 disabled:true、mode: !!js process.env.* 等降权写法，未触碰 sandbox、approval、permission 等安全配置行。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml only inserts a single line of plugin configuration, contains no privilege-lowering patterns such as disabled:true or mode: !!js process.env.*, and does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permission.

evidence.zh: 未发现 prepend 或高优监听 tools/pre-execute 或 approval/request 事件，不存在截断审批链或安全策略的途径。
evidence.en: No prepend or high-priority listeners on tools/pre-execute or approval/request events were found, so there is no way to truncate the approval chain or security policies.

evidence.zh: 不适用。本次为首版审计，无上一版本基线可比较版本间声明突变。
evidence.en: Not applicable. This is the first version audit, with no prior version baseline for comparing declaration mutations between versions.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 不包含 inject 或 intercept 配置改写，不存在通过 patch 给安全插件追加不存在的必需服务致其 pending 的风险。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml does not contain inject or intercept configuration rewrites, so there is no risk of appending a required service that does not exist to a security plugin via the patch, causing it to be pending.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否启动 Web 服务或监听端口。插件为纯浏览器端命令面板，不启动任何 HTTP 服务器或监听网络端口，不存在本机无认证 RPC 面。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a web service or listens on a port. The plugin is a pure browser-side command palette and does not start any HTTP server or listen on any network port, so there is no unauthenticated local RPC surface.

evidence.zh: 不适用。插件为浏览器端 client-only 插件，不启动 Web 服务器或监听任何端口，不存在本机无认证 RPC 面。
evidence.en: Not applicable. The plugin is a browser-side client-only plugin that does not start a web server or listen on any port, so there is no unauthenticated local RPC surface.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份校验通过。dsh.bundle.patch 和 dsh.client 声明完整，插件类型为 UI，无名称仿冒或身份异常。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed. The dsh.bundle.patch and dsh.client declarations are complete, the plugin type is UI, and there is no name impersonation or identity anomaly.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成。机器预扫 16 条命中经逐条裁决：DSH-P01（2 条）命中位于 SKILL.md 文档文字而非实际 YAML 配置，排除为良性；DSH-X10（7 条）命中模型面指令文件，内容为开发者文档，无恶意指令，排除为良性；DSH-X02 命中 install 钩子，prepare 脚本仅运行本地编译工具，排除为良性；DSH-X03（2 条）命中 child_process，位于开发期脚本，运行时无调用，排除为良性；DSH-X05（3 条）命中键盘监听器，为命令面板核心功能，排除为良性。
summary.en: Static scan completed. The 16 machine pre-scan hits were adjudicated one by one: DSH-P01 (2 hits) were in SKILL.md document text rather than actual YAML configuration, ruled benign; DSH-X10 (7 hits) were in model-facing instruction files whose content is developer documentation with no malicious instructions, ruled benign; DSH-X02 hits were in install hooks, with the prepare script only running local compilation tools, ruled benign; DSH-X03 (2 hits) involved child_process in development-time scripts with no runtime calls, ruled benign; DSH-X05 (3 hits) involved keyboard listeners that are core command palette functionality, ruled benign.

summary.zh: 行为分析未发现异常。prepare 脚本仅运行本地编译工具，无网络外联或敏感文件写入。无凭据读取、无外联、无混淆代码。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis found no anomalies. The prepare script only runs local compilation tools, with no outbound network connections or writes to sensitive files. No credential reads, no outbound connections, and no obfuscated code were found.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过。工具描述、系统提示词面均无注入风险。SKILL.md 和 AGENTS.md 为开发者协作文档，内容合规。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed. Both the tool description and system prompt surfaces have no injection risk. SKILL.md and AGENTS.md are developer collaboration documents with compliant content.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证。插件为浏览器端命令面板，无服务器端运行时行为可观测。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed. The plugin is a browser-side command palette with no server-side runtime behavior to observe.

target.en: dsh-spotlight@0.0.2#b3565e86 — Full audit (first version, no version baseline)

limits.en: L4 dynamic sandbox not enabled. The plugin is a browser-side command palette that is only effective at browser runtime, with no independent server-side process to observe.
